kind: manual predicate slice, generated anchor/hash verification

rows.predicate_branch: installed: managed import present AND instruction is a regular file
rows.reads_and_absence: CLAUDE.md bytes/type; managed rules bytes/type; fixed scope/name
rows.scope_or_exclusion: runtime=False; project scope excludes user runtime readiness; identity/metadata add conservative invalidation

rows.predicate_branch: journal exists with dictionary content OR malformed/unreadable journal -> recovery/conflict
rows.reads_and_absence: all .journal-*.json names, types and bytes in receiptcoordinator directory, including empty membership
rows.scope_or_exclusion: A committed-looking journal still requires recovery while present

rows.predicate_branch: new project-root reserved-name entry OR failed enumeration -> recovery/conflict
rows.reads_and_absence: project root identity; selected names start dot, contain .receiptcoordinator-tmp-, end .tmp; empty set is observed
rows.scope_or_exclusion: ordinary names and descendants are not queried by this predicate

rows.predicate_branch: reserved-name entry in managed directory OR failed enumeration -> recovery/conflict
rows.reads_and_absence: complete managed directory including type, presence, contents and membership
rows.scope_or_exclusion: scan errors yield evidence miss; no reuse of a partially observed snapshot

rows.predicate_branch: lock_present/lock_live are diagnostics, not recovery_required or installed
rows.reads_and_absence: lock file is conservatively included; live PID is not an input of normalized acceptance
rows.scope_or_exclusion: OS PID liveness excluded from N because it feeds neither accepted state nor blockers

rows.predicate_branch: non-runtime project query does not inspect settings, source code or root backups
rows.reads_and_absence: exclude ordinary files, nested source trees, .claude/settings.json and CLAUDE.md.bak_*
rows.scope_or_exclusion: exclusion applies to this pinned project invocation, not Claude user/runtime mode

rows.predicate_branch: config missing, abnormal, undecodable or conflicting TOML -> rejection/inactive
rows.scope_or_exclusion: fixed explicit --codex-dir and English output; no directory autodiscovery

rows.predicate_branch: manifest missing, invalid, abnormal or ownership mismatch -> non-active
rows.reads_and_absence: manifest schema; safe basename references; managed file identities/fingerprints
rows.scope_or_exclusion: manifest names are validated before joining to the tool root

rows.reads_and_absence: all root entries, including previously absent residue names
rows.scope_or_exclusion: full tree conservatively covers all residue name patterns

rows.predicate_branch: abnormal hook nodes, owned backup/fingerprint conflict -> rejection
rows.reads_and_absence: active/disabled hook types and relevant owned backup bytes/metadata
rows.scope_or_exclusion: status skips parsing live hook content where declared; full tree remains conservative

rows.predicate_branch: legacy file fingerprint/type can produce warnings or status errors
rows.reads_and_absence: legacy name, node type and file fingerprint
rows.scope_or_exclusion: warnings are distinguished from actual normalized blockers

rows.predicate_branch: outside files not reached through validated manifest references
rows.reads_and_absence: only the selected tool home plus code identities is sealed
rows.scope_or_exclusion: independent approved content/reference readback remains mandatory

rows.predicate_branch: root/rules/config abnormal, or missing/inactive compatibility state
rows.reads_and_absence: root identity; rule/config types and bytes; compatibility markers/values
rows.scope_or_exclusion: trusted paths constrain owned references to selected tool home

rows.predicate_branch: any transaction-prefix entry -> recovery, even if not a directory
rows.reads_and_absence: complete root membership and node type; empty prefix set
rows.scope_or_exclusion: entry presence is observed before interpreting journal contents

rows.reads_and_absence: manifest bytes and schema; canonical owned paths
rows.scope_or_exclusion: no trusted reference escapes the home validation domain

rows.predicate_branch: rule/config differs from managed after-state -> drift
rows.reads_and_absence: owned file content, identity and Windows normalized read-only metadata
rows.scope_or_exclusion: Windows normalized modes are determined by read-only state; Unix permission-bit equivalence is not claimed

rows.reads_and_absence: hook membership, original/disabled type and content
rows.scope_or_exclusion: restored and disabled states are compared through the original status

rows.predicate_branch: backup missing, abnormal or inconsistent with before-state -> drift
rows.scope_or_exclusion: the full-tree policy includes all validated backup references

rows.predicate_branch: extra rules/AGENTS/host version are diagnostic output
rows.reads_and_absence: extra rules and AGENTS are conservatively captured; fixed host lookup environment
rows.scope_or_exclusion: the measured PATH has no grok launcher; no arbitrary external program is inside this guarantee

not_claimed: exhaustive dynamic branch coverage or machine-checked source refinement
